scope: Steam session lifetime, one active Steam game, installation-operation guards, host connection observation
covered_cases: reservation before verification and duplicate requests
running game blocks download, verification and uninstall for its App ID
reservation survives sign-out until process exit
stale reservation events and release ignored
network disconnection and reconnection distinct from host loss
host loss leaves game session active
normal and nonzero immediate game exits
cancellation after spawning waits for actual exit
late gameStarted cannot overwrite a final report
test_repairs: Disposable Mach-O app fixture uses the standard Resources directory and must pass ad-hoc signature verification before execution. No system security setting is changed.
Termination result is stored by a callback installed before Process.run, avoiding the observed waitUntilExit hang.
